comment:
* Best-effort parser for HTTP dates.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: STANDARD_DATE_FORMAT
variables.comment:
* Most websites serve cookies in the blessed format. Eagerly create the parser to ensure such
   * cookies are on the fast path.

variables.name: BROWSER_COMPATIBLE_DATE_FORMAT_STRINGS
variables.comment: If we fail to parse a date in a non-standard format, try each of these formats in sequence.

methods.name: public static Date parse(String value)
methods.comment: Returns the date for {@code value}. Returns null if the value couldn't be parsed.
